How It Works

From first call to final walkthrough

1

Consultation & Measurements

We visit your home, measure the space, and talk through what you actually want out of it.

2

Design & Material Selection

Fixtures, tile, cabinetry, layout — locked in and priced before any work starts.

3

Demo & Rough-In

Old materials out, plumbing and electrical roughed in for the new layout.

4

Finish Work

Tile, cabinetry, fixtures, and paint — the space starts looking like the plan.

5

Final Walkthrough & Cleanup

Full site cleanup and a walkthrough with you before we call it done.
